dct_description_sm: Beaver Creek is an experimental road site where mitigation techniques, aiming to control permafrost degradation along the Alaska Highway, are being tested since implementation in summer 2008. The site comprises 12 sub-sections including a control sub-section.  Tomography scans were done to evaluate the volume occupied respectively by the ice, sediments, and gas phases within the Beaver Creek permafrost cores. It was also intended to show in 3D the ice structure within the sediments (cryostructure).
